bar.name: Deep Rot
bar.text: Withering you apply lasts 1 turn longer.

bar.name: Heart of the Wild
bar.text: Critical hits with your nature skills restore 4 MP.

bar.name: Tight Weave
bar.text: The root field from Nature's Wrath lasts 1 turn longer.

0.f1.name: Bitter Sap
0.f1.text: Nature's Grudge Withering deals +10% damage per rank.

0.f2.name: Spreading Spite
0.f2.text: When Nature's Grudge triggers, each enemy next to the killer has an 8% chance per rank to be gripped too.

0.f3.name: Choking Grip
0.f3.text: Withering deals +6% damage per rank on a Slowed enemy.

0.n0.name: Rot Remembers
0.n0.text: Nature's Grudge also triggers the first time an ally drops below 30% HP: that attacker starts Withering for 3 turns.

0.r.name: Bitter Balm
0.r.text: Nature's Grudge Withering heals your lowest-HP ally for 20% of each tick per rank.

0.ea.name: Creeping Blight
0.ea.text: When a Withering enemy dies, its Withering jumps to the nearest enemy with the turns it had left.

0.eb.name: Gnawing Rot
0.eb.text: Nature's Grudge Withering grows each turn it ticks: +10%, then +20%, then +30% and so on.

0.ma.name: Rot Bloom
0.ma.text: A Withering enemy that dies bursts: 40% INT nature damage to each enemy next to it, and they start Withering for 2 turns.

0.fa.name: Black Mold
0.fa.text: Withering you apply deals +30% damage, but Nature's Grudge no longer Slows.

0.fb.name: Grief's Toll
0.fb.text: Nature's Grudge Withering deals double damage, but each trigger costs you 10% of your max HP.

0.mb.name: Rot to the Core
0.mb.text: When Nature's Grudge Withering runs out, the killer takes half of all the damage it dealt once more.

0.v.name: Ever-Rot
0.v.text: Nature's Grudge becomes a blight: at the start of each of your turns, the enemy with the most HP starts Withering for 2 turns.

1.f1.name: Hooked Barbs
1.f1.text: Thorn Whip deals +3% damage per rank.

1.f2.name: Nettle Sting
1.f2.text: Thorn Whip has +2% critical chance per rank.

1.f3.name: Charged Lash
1.f3.text: After you cast an MP skill, your next Thorn Whip deals +5% damage per rank.

1.n0.name: Whip Crack
1.n0.text: Thorn Whip deals +50% damage to a target below 30% HP.

1.r.name: Keen Thorns
1.r.text: Thorn Whip's critical hits deal +8% damage per rank.

1.ea.name: Forked Thorn
1.ea.text: Thorn Whip chains to 1 more enemy for 60% damage; that enemy is Wounded too.

1.eb.name: Reaping Vine
1.eb.text: If Thorn Whip kills, you regain 6 MP.

1.ma.name: Thorn Volley
1.ma.text: When Thorn Whip crits, it lashes another enemy at once for 60% damage.

1.fa.name: Wild Thorns
1.fa.text: Thorn Whip deals +35% damage, but it can no longer crit.

1.fb.name: Cutting Haste
1.fb.text: Thorn Whip kills restore 15 MP, but it deals 20% less damage to targets above 50% HP.

1.mb.name: Endless Lash
1.mb.text: If Thorn Whip kills, your next turn comes twice as fast.

1.v.name: Thornstorm Lash
1.v.text: Thorn Whip splits into three lashes: each hits a random enemy for 45%, no Wound; each crit restores 3 MP.

2.f1.name: Grasping Earth
2.f1.text: Nature's Wrath has an 8% chance per rank to Slow each enemy hit for 2 turns.

2.f2.name: Tangleroot
2.f2.text: Nature's Wrath has a 5% chance per rank to Stun each enemy hit for 1 turn.

2.f3.name: Pollen Drift
2.f3.text: Enemies hit by Nature's Wrath deal 2% less damage per rank on their next turn.

2.n0.name: Root Field
2.n0.text: Nature's Wrath leaves a root field for 2 turns: enemies that start a turn there are Slowed for 1 turn.

2.r.name: Deep Tangle
2.r.text: Stuns from Nature's Wrath have a 10% chance per rank to last 1 turn longer.

2.ea.name: Hushing Moss
2.ea.text: The root field also Silences enemies that start a turn there.

2.eb.name: Grasp and Drag
2.eb.text: Nature's Wrath pulls each enemy in its back row one row forward.

2.ma.name: Overgrown Field
2.ma.text: The root field lasts 2 turns longer and deals 15% INT nature damage each turn.

2.fa.name: Mire
2.fa.text: The root field Slows on impact and lasts 4 turns, but Nature's Wrath cooldown 3 → 5.

2.fb.name: Briar Prison
2.fb.text: Nature's Wrath Stuns its first row for 1 turn, but deals no damage.

2.mb.name: Strangling Grove
2.mb.text: Nature's Wrath Stuns every Slowed enemy it hits for 1 turn.

2.v.name: Thicket Wave
2.v.text: Nature's Wrath strikes the same cells again at the start of your next turn: 50% damage and a 1-turn Stun (Rooted).

3.f3.name: Soft Hands
3.f3.text: Rejuvenate heals +4% more per rank on an ally below 50% HP.

3.n0.name: Overflowing Cup
3.n0.text: Healing from Rejuvenate beyond full HP becomes a shield of the same size.

3.r.name: Dewdrop Shield
3.r.text: Shields from Overflowing Cup +10% per rank.

3.ea.name: Spreading Roots
3.ea.text: Rejuvenate's regeneration also lands on allies next to the target at half strength.

3.eb.name: Emergency Bloom
3.eb.text: Rejuvenate heals +50% on an ally below 30% HP.

3.ma.name: Grove Bloom
3.ma.text: Rejuvenate's first heal also lands on every ally in the target's row.

3.fa.name: Thin Sap
3.fa.text: Rejuvenate heals every ally, but each heal is 50% weaker and its cooldown is 4.

3.fb.name: Desperate Sap
3.fb.text: Rejuvenate's regeneration lands all at once, +25%, but its cooldown is 4.

3.mb.name: Lifebloom
3.mb.text: When Rejuvenate's regeneration ends, the ally heals once more for the first heal's amount.

3.v.name: Verdant Link
3.v.text: Rejuvenate now links two allies: the target and your lowest-HP ally each get the full heal and regeneration.

4.u1.name: Crashing Arrival
4.u1.text: Summon Treant deals 50% INT nature damage to the enemy front row as it lands.

4.u2.name: Heavy Landing
4.u2.text: The arrival damage also hits the second row.

4.u3.name: Falling Oak
4.u3.text: The arrival damage +100%, and the enemy facing the Treant is Stunned for 1 turn.

4.r2.name: Heavy Smash
4.r2.text: Root Smash deals +25% damage to Slowed or Stunned enemies.

4.r3.name: Wrathful Oak
4.r3.text: The Treant acts twice per turn, but lives only 2 turns.

4.d1.name: Splinter Burst
4.d1.text: When the Treant dies or wilts, it bursts: 60% INT nature damage to the 2 nearest enemies.

4.d2.name: Brittle Bark
4.d2.text: The Treant's burst +50%, but the Treant has 20% less HP.

4.d3.name: Living Bomb
4.d3.text: You can cast Summon Treant while one stands: the old Treant bursts at once for double damage.

4.l1.name: Shieldbark
4.l1.text: The Treant arrives with Taunt for 1 turn.

4.l2.name: Thornbark
4.l2.text: Enemies that hit the Treant take 15% INT nature damage.

4.l3.name: Guardian Oak
4.l3.text: The Treant Guards the ally behind it: half the damage that ally takes goes to the Treant.
